Container.Name: marquee-shot
Container.Overview: Optional ESP32-panel sidecar for Marquee. Renders Marquee's real now-playing card with headless Chromium and serves it as a flat image (/card.jpg) plus a tiny /state.json change signal, so an ESP32 panel (e.g. Elecrow CrowPanel) can display the pixel-perfect card. REQUIRES a running Marquee on your LAN; it does NOT modify Marquee. Nest Hub users do not need this. Uses host networking — set "Marquee URL" to your Marquee address.
Container.Description: Optional ESP32-panel sidecar for Marquee (screenshot renderer). Opt-in add-on that runs alongside Marquee; not needed for Nest Hub casting.

Config.Name: Marquee URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your running Marquee (with host networking this is usually localhost)

Config.Name: Serve Port
Config.Description: Port this sidecar serves /card.jpg and /state.json on (must be free on the host)

Config.Name: Panel Width
Config.Description: Your ESP panel width in pixels

Config.Name: Panel Height
Config.Description: Your ESP panel height in pixels
